visual_style.art_style: Premium minimalism, photorealistic cinematic, editorial/magazine-quality lifestyle photography, subtle glassmorphism accents on app-UI moments only
visual_style.color_palette: Spinny Orange #F28C28 as sole saturated accent; Deep Navy #122840 and Blue #1B3A5C for grounding/interiors; Warm Gray #F8F9FA and Peach #FFB993 for soft daytime scenes; warm golden-hour tones throughout
visual_style.lighting: Warm, natural, golden-hour; soft shadows; no harsh or fluorescent lighting
visual_style.composition: Clean, uncluttered frames with intentional negative space; rule-of-thirds on hero subjects

motion_language.pacing: Apple-keynote-inspired: deliberate holds on key beats, smooth transitions, no chaotic fast cuts
motion_language.camera_style: Cinematic dolly/tracking/push shots; occasional slow handheld warmth; no shaky or whip-pan movement

subject_consistency.main_subject: Busy urban Canadian professional, 25-45, diverse/multicultural, modern casual-professional wardrobe, recurs as the customer throughline across all scenes
subject_consistency.environment: Modern Canadian metro condo/apartment interior and its doorstep/hallway; golden-hour interior light; no specific city landmarks

avoid: competitor brand colors (gold/yellow reading as Rinse)
laundry-only framing that ignores footwear/leather/home-textile scope
maintain: Spinny Orange (#F28C28) as the only saturated accent color
the 'time bought back' emotional payoff as the throughline
item variety across the montage: laundry, footwear, leather, home textiles
Spinny logo (orange-and-blue swirl 'S' mark) visible at payoff
